purpose: Finds files matching a specific pattern or predicate within a root directory.
capability: Searches directory tree with glob/fnmatch patterns.

output.matches: list of matching file path strings

interface: index.py -> find_file_path(root_path: str, pattern: str = '*', max_depth: int = -1) -> dict
composition: Can be combined with read-file-content or search-text-pattern.
failure_behavior: Returns empty list if no matches or path missing.
